name: BLE-04 引脚页纯点击编排 → 推送 → arrangementVersion 递增

steps.code: const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (!p || p.route !== 'pages/discover/discover') throw new Error('当前不在 discover 页：route=' + (p && p.route)); const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; for (;;) { const hit = (p.data.discovered || []).find((d) => d && (d.name === 'ML-8DCC' || d.deviceId === 'CC:8D:A2:C2:56:62')); if (hit) return { deviceId: hit.deviceId, name: hit.name, flow: p.data.flow }; if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('扫描结果无 ML-8DCC：discovered=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.discovered || []) + ' scanning=' + p.data.scanning + ' scanError=' + (p.data.addError || '')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.data.flow !== null) throw new Error('添加流程未收尾：flow=' + p.data.flow + ' scanning=' + p.data.scanning + ' addError=' + (p.data.addError || '')); const devices = p.data.devices || []; if (devices.length < 1) throw new Error('设备列表为空（连接/登记失败）：devices=' + JSON.stringify(devices)); return { flow: p.data.flow, deviceCount: devices.length };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.route !== 'pages/device/device') throw new Error('未进入设备页：route=' + p.route); if (p.data.connected !== true) throw new Error('设备页未连接：data=' + JSON.stringify({ connected: p.data.connected, reconnecting: p.data.reconnecting, transferMessage: p.data.transferMessage, name: p.data.name })); return { connected: p.data.connected, powerOn: p.data.powerOn };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.route !== 'pages/pin/pin') throw new Error('未进入 pin 页：route=' + p.route); return { pin: p.data.pinIndex, length: p.data.length, groupTabs: p.data.groupTabs.length };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.data.length !== 10) throw new Error('灯珠数未生效：length=' + p.data.length + ' lengthOpen=' + p.data.lengthOpen); if (p.data.cellCount !== 10) throw new Error('矩阵未出 10 格：cellCount=' + p.data.cellCount); return { length: p.data.length, cellCount: p.data.cellCount };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (p.data.selectedCount !== 1) throw new Error('点方格未选中 1 颗：selectedCount=' + p.data.selectedCount + ' freeCount=' + p.data.freeCount); return { selectedCount: p.data.selectedCount };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; if (!Array.isArray(p.data.stages) || p.data.stages.length !== 1) throw new Error('加阶段未生效：stages=' + JSON.stringify(p.data.stages || null)); return { stages: p.data.stages.length, totalLabel: p.data.totalLabel };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const raw = wx.getStorageSync('arrangement:' + p._deviceName); const arr = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; if (!arr) throw new Error('读回编排失败：storage 无 arrangement:' + p._deviceName); if (!arr.pendingPush) throw new Error('编辑未置 pendingPush：arr=' + JSON.stringify({ version: arr.version, pendingPush: arr.pendingPush })); return { version: arr.version, pendingPush: arr.pendingPush, pinLength: arr.pins[p.data.pinIndex] && arr.pins[p.data.pinIndex].length };
const r = await new Promise((resolve) => { wx.navigateBack({ success: () => resolve({ ok: true }), fail: () => resolve({ ok: false }) }); }); return r;
